entries.title: More ways to make hacking checks
entries.summary: Use supported game-system skill rolls, select a new roll from the character sheet, or configure custom dice with best-or-worst results and high-or-low success rules.

entries.title: Quick Hack and reusable challenges
entries.summary: GMs can choose a difficulty immediately with Quick Hack or save complete hacking challenges for compatible HoloSuite content such as terminal logins, files, messages, and cameras.

entries.title: Broader system and skill support
entries.summary: Native checks now support D&D 5e, Pathfinder 2e, Starfinder 2e, Call of Cthulhu 7e, and Cyberpunk RED, with clearer skill choices and setup guidance.

entries.title: Multiple scenes per star system
entries.summary: Galaxy Map systems can now link to multiple Foundry scenes, making it easier to organize and navigate locations across a campaign.

entries.title: Phantom token projections cleaned up
entries.summary: Camera feeds now filter token projections more reliably, preventing stale or hidden phantom tokens from appearing in live security views.

entries.title: Character names throughout CyberCall
entries.summary: Calls, contacts, messages, and group conversations now use assigned character names, with usernames retained as a fallback when no character is assigned.

entries.title: Smoother contract browsing
entries.summary: The Bounty Board title and filters now stay in place while long contract lists scroll independently, keeping search controls available even on a busy board.

entries.title: Critical cut-ins for more dice
entries.summary: Choose from standard and registered dice, decide whether high or low results are positive, and configure separate success and failure thresholds for each character.

entries.title: More reliable cut-in detection
entries.summary: Improved Foundry 14 support and prevented old chat rolls, damage rolls, discarded dice, and rerolls from triggering unwanted animations.

entries.title: Evidence images open from item cards
entries.summary: Evidence image controls now open their full image previews from CSI item cards, making case-board evidence easier to inspect at the table.

entries.title: Fresh updates across HoloSuite
entries.summary: The What's New feed now highlights the latest Hacking, CyberCall, Bounty Board, and Critical Cut-In improvements.

entries.title: Configurable vending machines join HoloSuite
entries.summary: Build scene-linked vending machines with Alien Market, Neon, Executive Terminal, or Corporate Kiosk styling, limited stock, item-currency purchases, and Region-based access controls.

entries.title: Interactive sci-fi terminals join HoloSuite
entries.summary: Turn terminals into playable locations with configurable mail, files, camera feeds, utilities, authentication, hacking, permissions, encounter-driven downloads, and distinct visual themes.

entries.title: Cinematic scanner pulses join HoloSuite
entries.summary: Reveal GM-placed scan targets with a table-ready scanner pulse, visibility controls, range handling, and system-agnostic target data.

entries.title: Ship loadouts join HoloSuite
entries.summary: Create system-agnostic ship profiles with equipment slots, power allocation, damage tracking, ship-image pins, and player-facing install or activation permissions.
